name: theluxuryliners-com
description: theluxuryliners.com: the official site of The Luxury Liners. Astro static site + a Cloudflare Worker (contact form, 410s). Scaffolded from the daviddewese.com site.

scripts.build: node scripts/validate-data.mjs --quiet && node scripts/prepare-images.mjs && node scripts/build-redirects.mjs && astro build && node scripts/build-redirects.mjs --check
scripts.test:unit: node tests/run.mjs data unit dist jsonld
scripts.build:production: RELEASE=1 npm run build && RELEASE=1 node scripts/check-dist.mjs
